laws.name: Vermont Parental and Family Leave Act (PFLA)
laws.description: Provides job-protected unpaid leave for parental bonding, family caregiving, and the employee’s own serious illness.

laws.name: Vermont Short-Term Family Leave
laws.description: Provides job-protected short-term leave for routine family needs such as school activities, medical appointments, or professional meetings related to a family member’s care.

laws.name: Vermont Earned Sick Time Law
laws.description: Provides paid sick time for medical needs, family caregiving, public health emergencies, and safe leave related to domestic or sexual violence.

laws.name: Vermont Safe Leave
laws.description: Provides job-protected leave for victims of domestic violence, sexual assault, or stalking to seek medical care, counseling, legal assistance, or safety services.

laws.name: Vermont State Employee Sick Leave
laws.description: Provides paid sick leave for eligible Vermont state employees for personal illness or injury.

laws.name: Vermont State Employee Family Sick Leave
laws.description: Allows Vermont state employees to use accrued sick leave to care for an immediate family member with an illness or injury.
